scenarios.title: Add unpacked items and render markup-like text literally

steps.caption: 1. The hosted desktop app opens with an empty packing list and clear add and filter controls.
2. Passport appears as a new To pack item.
3. Three unpacked items retain insertion order, and Hat is visibly rendered as literal text.

scenarios.title: Rename a packed item without changing its state

steps.caption: 4. Rain coat is visibly packed while Socks remains To pack.
5. Rain coat is in focused rename mode with explicit Save and Cancel actions.
6. Jacket replaces Rain coat in place and remains visibly packed; Socks is unchanged.

scenarios.title: Pack, filter, unpack, and show the completed state

steps.caption: 7. The All view shows Passport and Socks as To pack.
8. Passport is marked Packed with a checked control and crossed-out name; Socks remains To pack.
9. The selected To pack view shows Socks and hides packed Passport.
10. Returning to All restores both items with their packed states intact.
11. Passport can be marked not packed again from the All view.
12. With every item packed, To pack shows the dedicated Nothing left to pack state.

scenarios.title: Delete one item and then empty the list

steps.caption: 13. Passport, Socks, and Jacket are present before deletion.
14. Socks is gone while Passport and Jacket remain in their original order.
15. Deleting the final rows returns the app to its empty-list state.

scenarios.title: Keep renamed, packed, and deleted state across refresh

steps.caption: 16. Before refresh, Jacket is packed, Socks is To pack, and deleted Hat is absent.
17. After a real reload, Jacket and Socks keep their saved states, Hat stays deleted, and the app returns to All.

scenarios.title: Reject blank names and recover without changing saved items

steps.caption: 18. Passport is the known-good saved item and is visibly packed.
19. A whitespace-only add is rejected with an inline message and creates no row.
20. A valid Socks item is added after the rejected input while packed Passport stays unchanged.
21. A blank rename stays in edit mode with an associated validation message.
22. Cancel closes the invalid rename and restores packed Passport unchanged.
23. Reload shows only the valid saved items: packed Passport and unpacked Socks.
